name: em-qa-mobile
description: Mobile QA for Flutter apps on real devices: builds human-style test cases from project docs, a test plan and Appium exploration (one file per platform); executes them as WebdriverIO + TypeScript Appium scripts with MD/XLSX results, bug files (screenshot, MP4 recording, device log) and a test report; and files the bugs into Jira (web and mobile) with links written back.
